definitions.gloss: mixed with soda water; diluted with carbonated water
definitions.explanation: A way of drinking alcohol or other beverages by mixing them with carbonated water (soda water). A common way to order drinks in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦ウイスキー→ウイスキー：00412_uisukii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{炭酸割|たんさんわ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{焼酎|しょうちゅう}→焼酎：19874_shouchuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{炭酸割|たんさんわ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧だ。
examples.english: Shochu mixed with soda water is popular.

examples.japanese: ⟦{梅酒|うめしゅ}→梅酒：16869_umeshu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{炭酸割|たんさんわ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{飲|の}みやすい→飲みやすい：21767_nomiyasui⟧。
examples.english: Plum wine is easy to drink when mixed with soda water.

notes:
USAGE:
The suffix {割|わ}り means 'diluted with' and is used with various mixers: ⟦{水割|みずわ}り→水割り：16023_mizuwari⟧ (with water), ⟦{湯割|ゆわ}り→湯割り：28908_yuwari⟧ (with hot water), {炭酸割|たんさんわ}り (with soda). Very common when ordering drinks at izakaya and bars.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{焼酎|しょうちゅう}→焼酎：19874_shouchuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{炭酸割|たんさんわ}り (shochu highball)
- ⟦{梅酒|うめしゅ}→梅酒：16869_umeshu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{炭酸割|たんさんわ}り (plum wine soda)
- {炭酸割|たんさんわ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to mix with soda)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{水割|みずわ}り→水割り：16023_mizuwari⟧: mixed with water
- ⟦{湯割|ゆわ}り→湯割り：28908_yuwari⟧: mixed with hot water
- ⟦ハイボール→ハイボール：27604_haibooru⟧: highball (whisky and soda)
